task.text: 用英语回答Compare and contrast the theories of behaviorism and innatism in language acquisition.

attempts.high: I'm putting together a teaching module on language acquisition and I want an original way to frame the behaviorism vs. innatism debate. Come up with your own structure, your own angle, maybe an analogy or scenario that makes the contrast click — whatever you think teaches it best. Your call on how to present it, just keep it focused on comparing and contrasting the two theories.
attempts.low: Compare and contrast behaviorism and innatism in language acquisition using exactly this structure: paragraph 1 defines behaviorism (Skinner, stimulus-response, reinforcement). Paragraph 2 defines innatism (Chomsky, Universal Grammar, the poverty of the stimulus argument). Paragraph 3 lists their similarities. Paragraph 4 lists their differences. Stick to the standard textbook content, no added examples or framing of your own.
reasons: leakage on non-target axis 'warmth': HIGH=4, LOW=2 (differ by 2, max allowed 1). Equalize this dimension across the two versions.
competence check failed: verifier judges the two versions to demand different underlying skills. Keep the required competences identical.
